name: strzelichowski-solutions
description: Claude Code plugins by Strzelichowski Solutions: session handoff, context guards and a self-hosted model for private files

plugins.name: context-guard
plugins.description: Session handoff (/context-guard:handoff), handoff reminder at 60% and auto-compact at 65% context, usage limits on the status line, and a token ceiling for Haiku 5.5 subagents; all configurable in /config

plugins.name: self-hosted-model
plugins.description: Claude Code on your own OpenAI-compatible model in one private folder (/self-hosted-model:setup), with Word and Excel support and a guard that keeps Claude sessions out of that folder; macOS
